verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a "full REST API" covering flag toggling and experiment results, and a hands-on probe created a user, org, feature and SDK connection through the API. However, the docs say some risky API changes are held until a person confirms them in the GrowthBook UI, and no endpoint inventory shows full UI parity. Missing for 10: documented proof of UI-to-API parity across all features (metrics, approvals, visual editor, dashboards), a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), and API completion of actions currently gated on in-UI confirmation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: GrowthBook offers a full REST API for interacting with the application.
automate it (for example, from a deploy script) with the toggle feature endpoint, which switches a flag on or off in one or more environments.
Get results for an experiment (`GET /v1/experiments/{id}/results`) to pull the latest analysis into your own reporting.
the first user and organization were created through the API, a boolean feature `pa-probe-flag` was created, an SDK connection was minted
Require confirmation holds risky changes until a person confirms them in GrowthBook.
